title: Vidya 'Vee' Dinamani (the SDSU fireside moderator) on Incorruptible — 'soul ... It's entirely structural. He gives us the playbook.'
summary: Vidya 'Vee' Dinamani — Product Excellence Leader, founder of Product Rebels, author of Groundwork, and the moderator of the Eric Ries SDSU fireside — posts a substantive reflection from her own perspective on stage with Eric.
blockquote: But he doesn't just name the problem. He shows us exactly what to do to protect a company's soul. Yes, soul. It sounds abstract. It's entirely structural. He gives us the playbook.
